name: file_kind_cover_letter_basic
spec: "cover" when the label mentions a cover letter ("cover letter", "coverletter")...

name: file_kind_coverletter_one_word
spec: "cover" when the label mentions a cover letter ("cover letter", "coverletter")...

name: file_kind_motivational_letter
spec: "cover" when the label mentions ... a motivation / motivational letter...

name: file_kind_letter_of_motivation
spec: ... or a letter of interest / letter of motivation.

name: file_kind_letter_of_interest_lowercase
spec: "cover" when the label mentions ... a letter of interest / letter of motivation. ... Case-insensitive.

name: file_kind_references_plural
spec: Else "reference" when it mentions reference or recommendation (letters of recommendation are the candidate's own documents).

name: file_kind_letter_of_recommendation
spec: Else "reference" when it mentions reference or recommendation (letters of recommendation are the candidate's own documents).

name: file_kind_transcript_uppercase
spec: Else "transcript" when it mentions transcript. ... Case-insensitive.

name: file_kind_resume_cv
spec: Everything else is "resume" ("Resume/CV", ...).

name: file_kind_upload_a_file_generic
spec: Everything else is "resume" (..., "Upload a file", ...).

name: file_kind_empty_label
spec: Everything else is "resume" (..., empty label).

name: file_kind_attachments_uppercase
spec: Everything else is "resume" (..., "Attachments", ...). Case-insensitive.

name: resume_empty_field_no_cover_wanted
spec: kind "resume": the résumé unless the field already shows a file ... ; then additionally the cover letter when want_cover is true AND the input accepts multiple files...

name: resume_empty_field_want_cover_multi
spec: kind "resume": the résumé ... ; then additionally the cover letter when want_cover is true AND the input accepts multiple files AND the cover name is not already in field_text AND cover is not null.

name: resume_want_cover_but_single_file_field
spec: then additionally the cover letter when want_cover is true AND the input accepts multiple files AND the cover name is not already in field_text AND cover is not null.

name: resume_field_already_shows_success
spec: kind "resume": the résumé unless the field already shows a file (the text contains "successful", ...) — never a second résumé.

name: resume_field_shows_resume_pdf_want_cover
spec: kind "resume": the résumé unless the field already shows a file (the text contains "successful", or a name ending in .pdf / .doc / .docx) — never a second résumé; then additionally the cover letter when want_cover is true AND the input accepts multiple files AND the cover name is not already in field_text AND cover is not null.

name: resume_field_shows_other_docx
spec: kind "resume": the résumé unless the field already shows a file (the text contains "successful", or a name ending in .pdf / .doc / .docx) — never a second résumé.

name: resume_field_shows_cover_only
spec: then additionally the cover letter when want_cover is true AND the input accepts multiple files AND the cover name is not already in field_text AND cover is not null.

name: resume_cover_null_want_cover_multi
spec: then additionally the cover letter when want_cover is true AND the input accepts multiple files AND the cover name is not already in field_text AND cover is not null.

name: cover_kind_empty_field
spec: kind "cover": [cover] unless that exact name already appears in field_text; null cover -> [].

name: cover_kind_already_uploaded
spec: kind "cover": [cover] unless that exact name already appears in field_text.

name: cover_kind_no_cover_file
spec: kind "cover": [cover] unless that exact name already appears in field_text; null cover -> [].

name: reference_kind_never_uploads
spec: kind "reference" or "transcript": [] always (the candidate provides those).

name: transcript_kind_never_uploads
spec: kind "reference" or "transcript": [] always (the candidate provides those).

name: resume_cover_field_shows_doc_extension
spec: kind "resume": the résumé unless the field already shows a file (the text contains "successful", or a name ending in .pdf / .doc / .docx) — never a second résumé.
